Message.Name: Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the firm over the AIS Retransmission Interface (SesM Unsequenced Data Packet) to request a Last Value Refresh of a particular data set identified by Refresh Message Type.

Field.Name: Refresh Message Type
Field.Description: Identifies the data set the firm is requesting a refresh of.

Message.Name: Refresh Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by MIAX Options over the AIS Retransmission Interface (SesM Unsequenced Data Packet) carrying one Application Message that satisfies a previous Refresh Request. Note: MIAX Options PDF assigns Response Type "R" (uppercase) to this message, colliding with the Request Type "R" byte; lowercase "r" is used here to match the Pearl convention for case-distinct discrimination.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Original sequence number from the live feed.

Field.Name: Application Message
Field.Description: Retransmitted application message based on the message type requested.

Message.Name: End of Refresh Notification Message
Message.Description: Sent by MIAX Options over the AIS Retransmission Interface (SesM Unsequenced Data Packet) when the refresh response is complete.

Field.Name: Refresh Message Type
Field.Description: Echoes the Refresh Message Type from the originating Refresh Request.
